brief:
Israeli forces detained or interrogated approximately 95 Palestinians across the occupied West Bank overnight, the Palestinian Prisoners' Society reported Thursday. The organization characterized the campaign as part of a broader operation, though details of the sweep's scope and stated objectives were not immediately specified.

The detention operations occurred simultaneously across multiple locations in the West Bank. The Prisoners' Society, which monitors arrest activity and conditions in Israeli custody, did not provide names or ages of those detained or the specific communities targeted in the overnight campaign.

title: Israeli forces detain 95 Palestinians across West Bank overnight
